scope: Files specified by the instrument guide and named analytical products. A shared ledger can be updated in more than one stage. Reading URLs resolve relative to the stage page.

groups.purpose: The review of instructions and interventions
groups.description: handling-E2.md records conflicting directions, obstacles, helpful practices and the use or removal of discretion. Each point leads back to the event or instruction it rests on.

groups.purpose: A design argument for the next version
groups.description: next-instrument-E2.md proposes a revised process, with reasons drawn from this run and the risks of each change. It is a recommendation for future work; the completed analysis keeps the contract it ran under.
notes-E2.md keeps the stage's decisions and open questions. handback-E2.md gives the operator the lessons and proposed changes, listed apart from repairs already made.

out/interview/E2b.md records what the aggregator did, found and doubted, and what it would like to be asked. A checkpoint interview can explore that saved view; it leaves the original run unchanged, and its new answers are dated to the interview.
The aggregator’s closing account of this stage and what it passed to the next.
